verdict.rationale: Zep is consumed entirely via SDK/API calls (e.g., three-lines-of-code integration, thread.add_messages, graph.edge.delete) which are inherently scriptable/headless, and it ships a dedicated CLI (zepctl) for administering projects, managing users/threads/graphs from the terminal — both suitable for CI/automation pipelines. Missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD pipeline example, GitHub Actions integration, or docs specifically addressing headless/CI usage patterns.
